baseline_v9.model: 88% CatBoost Depth 4 5-seed ensemble + 12% regularized Logistic Regression

phase_b_depth_diagnostic.key_takeaway: Optimal tree depth is strictly Depth 3 (peaks at 0.86835 standalone, beating V9 champion without blending). Pure additive stumps collapse by -43 bps (0.86393), proving 2-way and 3-way interactions are mandatory, but depths >= 4 overfit.

significant_biases.interpretation: V9 systematically overpredicts churn in the central region by 1.17 percentage points (p < 0.001).
V9 systematically overpredicts annual plan churn by ~10% relative error (predicting 5.56% vs true 5.08%).
Missing payment method represents extreme churn risk (46.7%), well identified by is_pm_missing.

monthly_billing_auc.observation: Monthly billing AUC is stable across all months (only 37 bps lower in March).

annual_billing_auc.observation: Annual billing AUC collapses by 261 bps in March (0.8661 vs 0.8922 in Feb and 0.8895 in Apr). The entire Fold 2 deficit is isolated to annual subscribers.

partner_channel_auc.observation: Partner channel experiences a 328 bps drop in March.

phase_e_lomo_diagnostics.conclusion: March has intrinsic lower signal-to-noise in annual renewals, but adding diverse training exposure improves it by +0.00168.

phase_f_artifact_audit.pricing_mechanics: Annual plans offer an exact 20% discount across Basic, Standard, and Premium tiers.
phase_f_artifact_audit.referral_code_structure: 300 unique 6-character strings all starting with R; zero parsing artifacts.

phase_g_lifecycle_audit.observation_window_findings: Jan 31 snapshot has 120.0 observable days; 14d, 30d, 60d, 90d, 120d windows have 100% complete coverage for all snapshot months. Mean events per customer is constant (~26.5) across all train and test months. Zero temporal horizon truncation for windowed features.

phase_h_renewal_phase_audit.conclusion: Annual churn is completely flat with respect to anniversary timing (p = 0.71). Annual subscribers do not churn in an anniversary spike; hypothesis rejected.

core_pillars: 1. Adopt Depth-3 Oblivious Trees (demonstrated +0.00011 gain standalone over V9 champion blend)
2. Billing-Cycle Specialized Experts (train dedicated models on Annual vs Monthly to address the 261 bps March collapse in Annual)
3. Segment-Level Residual Calibration (correct the -1.17% overprediction bias in Central region and -0.48% in Annual billing)
